What the brief says: Guppi must resolve words like "Sunday", "this Sunday", "next Sunday" and "another Sunday" in every language.
Assumption made (nothing structural was: Proposed: a bare weekday or "this/aa" = the first such day after today (said on that same weekday: asked, today or +7; "this/aa" on that day = today). "next/upcoming/aavta/agle" = the first after today (a week on if today is that day). "another/bijo" = a week after the day already being discussed (asked if none). The exact date is always shown before any hold. DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel, his words): "YES, approved. Relative dates such as Sunday, next Sunday and equivalent Gujarati/Hindi/Romanized expressions are approved. Resolve them using the applicable customer/local date context. If the intended date is genuinely ambiguous, ask the customer rather than guessing." Tested: REL-LANG-008, -013, -014, -017, -034.
Effect if the assumption is wrong: Customers may mean a different Sunday; every case is shown as an exact date before a hold, so no wrong booking is made silently.

What the brief says: "ground koi pan chale" (any ground will do).
Assumption made (nothing structural was: Proposed: any ground of the SAME KIND (a match ground, not practice nets), the preferred ground first; offers still come from Daji and each shows its ground. DECISION (27 Oct 2026, Sunny Patel, his words): "YES. If no ground is specified, eligible grounds may be searched. If a ground is specified, preserve it. If it is unavailable, Guppi may offer other grounds as alternatives, but the customer must select the alternative. Do not silently substitute grounds." Tested: REL-LANG-020 (the named ground is kept and no other ground is offered until the customer says any ground will do; then other grounds are tagged as another ground).
Effect if the assumption is wrong: If any bookable place should count, nets could be offered for a match request.
